TZA.note: No government data exchange platform is described.

facts.fact: Government spokesman Gerson Msigwa said that by August 2026 institutions were linked to NIDA's registration and identification system and could verify the identity of the people they serve.

Msigwa said use of the national ID number has spread across sectors including taxpayer registration, financial services, health insurance, higher-education loans, TASAF social services and business registration.
Msigwa said 157 institutions, 72 government and 85 private, were linked to the NIDA system by August 2026.

TZA.note: Nothing on a government interoperability framework.
Nothing on a data sharing law.
